_comment: GoaRAG's own docs disagree with themselves on which embedding model is actually live: .env.example states intfloat/multilingual-e5-small as the default, but the documented example responses for /api/query (providers.embedding) and /api/stats (embeddingModel) both show BAAI/bge-m3. This config follows the latter since it's what their own example RESPONSES show running, not just a stated default -- but verify against the real instance's own GET /api/health or /api/stats before trusting this, per their own warning: getting this wrong degrades retrieval silently rather than erroring. If it turns out to really be e5-small: model_name -> intfloat/multilingual-e5-small, query_prefix -> 'query: ', passage_prefix -> 'passage: ' (both non-empty, mean pooling).
